Fetched 2026-06-23, branch main, all 200. There is NO catalyst endpoint for this flow: deleting a local scene project is a desktop/Electron filesystem op (deleteProject IPC). The project list below is a faithful local-fixture stand-in for the renderer's in-memory project store; the actual removal is SIMULATED client-side in the route (no fs write).
